summary: Source Data column distributions now show the shape of concentrated columns instead of a single spike beside a flat line.
details: Histograms are drawn across the central 0.5%-99.5% range, so a few far outliers no longer squash the whole column into one bar; the true minimum and maximum still print below the chart.
Bar heights use a square-root scale and the counts are smoothed, so long tails stay visible and the shape reads as a continuous distribution.
Numeric columns get up to 40 bars instead of 16, capped so a low-cardinality column cannot comb into alternating full and empty bars.
The row distribution mark is now a smooth curve, and empty bins render as empty instead of a dashed baseline that looked like data.
Hovering an end bar of a clipped range shows it as open-ended rather than claiming a range it does not cover.
